messages.text:
I can see the bug. In `lib/logger.ts`, the `log()` method uses `>` instead of `>=`:

```js
if (this._logLevel > LogLevel.All) {  // BUG: should be >=
```

When `LogLevel` is set to `All` (value 3), `3 > 3` is `false`, so `log()` never prints. This causes the test to get `[LogLevel.Warnings, LogLevel.Errors]` instead of the expected `[LogLevel.All, LogLevel.Warnings, LogLevel.Errors]`.

Let me fix it:
